summary: Pru PLc filed Form 6-K disclosing share repurchases from JP Morgan, buying ~1.99M own shares over 1-5 June 2026 at avg ~10.09 GBP each, under authority from the 2025 AGM & a 6 Jan 2026 buyback programme. Shares will be cancelled, reducing overhang; post-buyback shares outstanding 2.517B. The on-exchange purchases comply with LSE & HK Code rules. Since the programme began, 36.9M shares were repurchased at VWAP 1,116.35p. Watch pace of future buybacks vs. announced programme capacity.
